_comment: PHYSICAL FACTS about each QCar -- the single source for every script (dataset builders, qcar/patches/patch_real_extrinsic.py, visualize, realtime). Change it only when something is re-measured, and record the source. Paths and run parameters do NOT belong here (they live in each script's conf.json); scene facts (walls, parked cars) live in data/qcar_dataset/pipeline/shared/scene.json. Agent ids ('1', '2') are fixed per physical car and never derived from IPs.

footprints._comment: Vicon-origin -> exterior-box-centre offsets and box length/width live ONLY in 'file' (next to this one): a byte-exact copy of the lab's measurement record (Desktop/Dataset/PhD_research_tools/physical_vehicle_footprints.json on the lab PC, used by the collision labeller). Readers refuse it if its SHA256 differs from 'sha256', so a re-measurement must be copied in and acknowledged here.
footprints.measured: 2026-10-09, lab session Data Collection (vault note '2026-10-09 0000 - REFERENCIA — QCar Vicon measured offsets 2026-10-09'). File status field: unmeasured_candidate.
footprints.box_height_source: QCar height used since the first dataset (not in the footprints file)

1.name: qcar-52775
1._camera_extrinsic_note: Manufacturer extrinsic chosen 2026-10-14 (decision: same geometry for both cars, in building and training). qcar52775_refined is kept below as the first thing to try if detection degrades; the zoo models trained before 2026-10-14 used its R.

2.name: qcar-52776
2._assumption: the car recorded as agent 2 in ExperimentNo1 (Sept) is this same physical car; unconfirmed as of 2026-10-14.

targets._comment: Non-agent vehicles whose pose comes from Vicon; a session's dynamic_target.vehicle names one of these.

camera_extrinsics._comment: Front camera -> vehicle body: R_cb (3x3, rows) and t_cb_m (metres, body frame). cam_cords_mount names the entry whose t_cb_m places camera0's cords in every agent yaml; the rotation is applied at training time by patch_real_extrinsic.py.

manual_nominal.source: Quanser QCar user_manual_system_hardware.pdf p.9 (Quanser_Qcar_Calibration), matrix csi_front_to_body. det(R_cb) = +1 when computed, although the manual's text says -1.

qcar52775_refined.source: qcar-52775 front camera, refined 2026-09-14 from 19 image/Vicon click correspondences (0.46-2.9 m, full yaw range), median reprojection error 7.7 px. NOT USED since 2026-10-14 (vehicles use manual_nominal); kept as the alternative to test first if detection degrades.
